Requirements:
- Breadcrumb: Home > Student Portal > My Resources.
- Page Header:
  - Title: "My Resources" with subtle icon or badge.
  - Subtitle: "Practice files, notes and downloads from your enrolled courses".
  - Quick actions on the right: "Download All Enrolled Assets (ZIP)" outline button and "Cloud Sync" indicator.
- Summary KPI / stat chips at top:
  - Interactive/clickable filter pills or metric cards:
    - "All Resources (24)"
    - "8 PDF Notes & Guides" (with PDF icon badge)
    - "4 Practice Files (.xlsx / .pbix)" (with spreadsheet icon badge)
    - "2 Financial & BI Templates" (with template icon badge)
    - "6 SQL & Code Scripts"
    - "4 Capstone Prompts"
- Filter and search toolbar:
  - Course dropdown filter: "All Courses" (with options: Advanced Excel Masterclass, SQL for Modern Data Analysis, Power Query & Automated ETL, Python for Business Dashboards).
  - Type dropdown filter: "All Types" (PDF Notes, Cheat Sheets, Practice Files, Templates, Assignments).
  - Search input: "Search resources by file name, keyword or lesson..."
  - Sort dropdown: "Sort: Course Order / Recently Added"
  - View toggle: Table list view (selected) vs Grid cards view.
- Grouped Resource Tables / Card Sections by Course:

  GROUP 1 (Expanded):
  - Course Group Header:
    - Course title: "Advanced Excel Masterclass: Dynamic Arrays & Financial Modeling"
    - Course progress tag: "68% Complete • 18 of 26 lessons finished"
    - Quick action: "Collapse" toggle icon and "Download Available Batch (.zip, 48.2 MB)".
  - Table / Row List:
    1. Row 1:
       - File type icon: Red PDF icon badge.
       - Resource Name: "powerquery-cheatsheet.pdf" (with subtitle: "Essential M-code syntax, date transformers & custom columnar formulas").
       - Type chip: "Cheat Sheet" (soft slate/indigo badge).
       - Linked Lesson: "Power Query: Cleaning Messy Data" (Section 3 • Lesson 4) with clickable link style.
       - Size: "2.4 MB".
       - Actions: "View" outline button with eye icon, and primary "Download" indigo button with download icon.
    2. Row 2:
       - File type icon: Green XLSX spreadsheet icon badge.
       - Resource Name: "practice-dataset-dirty-sales.xlsx" (with subtitle: "Raw multi-header unpivoted transactional records with 45,000 rows").
       - Type chip: "Practice File" (emerald badge).
       - Linked Lesson: "Power Query: Cleaning Messy Data" (Section 3 • Lesson 4).
       - Size: "8.1 MB".
       - Actions: "View" outline button, and primary "Download" indigo button.
    3. Row 3 (Protected / View-only):
       - File type icon: Blue DOC/PDF icon badge.
       - Resource Name: "executive-financial-modeling-standard-sop.pdf" (with subtitle: "Deloitte & BICE proprietary financial statement reconciliation standards").
       - Type chip: "Reference SOP" (blue badge).
       - Linked Lesson: "Section 1: Modern Excel Architecture & Dynamic Formulas".
       - Size: "5.6 MB".
       - Actions: "View" outline button, and disabled/protected badge: "View only (Watermarked)" with an eye and lock icon, indicating restricted enterprise download policy.
    4. Row 4 (Locked item):
       - File type icon: Gray/Amber locked file icon badge.
       - Resource Name: "capstone-lbo-model-template-unlocked.xlsx".
       - Type chip: "Template" (amber badge).
       - Linked Lesson: "Section 4: Executive Dashboard UI & Capstone Valuation".
       - Size: "14.2 MB".
       - Status / Action: Lock icon with pill and tooltip badge: "🔒 Unlocks after Lesson 6 (Automating Refreshes)". Action button disabled: "Locked".

  GROUP 2 (Expanded):
  - Course Group Header:
    - Course title: "SQL for Modern Data Analysis & Warehousing"
    - Course progress tag: "45% Complete • 14 of 40 lessons finished"
  - Rows:
    1. Blue .SQL script file: "ecommerce_clickstream_schema.sql" • Type: "Code Script" • Linked: "Module 2: CTEs & Window Functions" • Size: "185 KB" • Actions: View & Download.
    2. Red PDF: "window-functions-syntax-poster.pdf" • Type: "Cheat Sheet" • Linked: "Module 4: Running Totals & Quartiles" • Size: "3.2 MB" • Actions: View & Download.

  GROUP 3 (Collapsed state demonstration as requested):
  - Course Group Header:
    - Course title: "Power Query & Automated ETL: Corporate Pipelines"
    - Subtitle / stats: "6 files (32.4 MB) • 15% Complete"
    - Collapsed chevron indicator (pointing right) and "Expand to view 6 items" button.

- Polished Footer helper banner:
  - "Need customized team datasets or enterprise sandbox access? Contact Academic Operations Desk".
